headline: Missile Battle gets its second console
lede: Two-player is live at jalfern.com/retrogames/missile-battle — the arcade's alternating batteries, honest to the 1980 law and byte-identical solo — and the never-dry ladder grew a BLOCKED marker so fidelity-blocked gaps finally stop stealing free lanes.

notes.text: MISSILE BATTLE 2P: waves alternate whose sector burns (cyan west / amber east, shared reserve in the middle), per-player ledgers, fallen-sector rescue, and the autopilot seats 2 by default. Two humans share one keyboard — no second pad, per the house rule. Solo mode hashes pinned; every duo wave holds both sectors one round lighter per tube.
Gates: missilecheck 593/593 (+56 alternating-battery pins, 3 new named mutants — all die), missileplay 37/37 with real keys grading the sector refusal and the dead second console, attractcheck 694.

Ladder honesty: parseGaps now skips **BLOCKED** bullets the way it skips CLOSED ones — BoulderDash's amoeba-reactivity and pull gaps carry their reasons and unblock conditions and no longer score for the weakest-stage kick. The shelf sank on its own: next pick is GardenGuard.
